milestone: Genuine XNU VM Initialization, Physical Page Management & Kernel Memory Services

tests.description: Independently validates that Level-2 descriptor 0x000000023A000705ULL accurately maps AIC2 MMIO registers (0x23B100000) 1:1, correcting the 416 MiB displacement bug.
Verifies 8 MiB physical DRAM limits, 496 free pages, and invalidation of Level-2 Slot 1 (0x0ULL) to eradicate 32MB ghost memory.
Ensures that all guest execution symbols (arm_init, pmap_bootstrap, pmap_init, vm_page_bootstrap) have explicit source line provenance mapped to Apple xnu-10002.1.13.
Validates binary layout, alignment, and size of xnu_page_metadata_header_t (32B), pmap_phys_attributes (512B), and xnu_vm_page_t (8B).
Tests physical page allocator single/multi-page allocation, reserved range protections, double-free rejection, and exhaustion limits.
Executes compiled genuine guest XNU code, verifying that pmap_init and vm_page_bootstrap populate guest memory at 0x28000, 0x28020, and 0x28220.
Validates kernel VA layout and gap protections, ensuring accesses to unmapped ranges (ghost RAM slot 1 and high gaps) trigger Translation Faults.
Tests simulated kernel mapping services: map, unmap, protect (RW -> RO), and lookup with TLB invalidation.
Verifies W^X memory protection enforcement across Stage-1 page tables (AP[2]=1 read-only execution vs UXN/PXN non-executable writable memory).
Tests TLB invalidation lifecycle (TLBI VMALLE1IS and TLBI VAE1IS) preventing stale translation exploits.
Validates architectural exception dispatch, FAR_EL1 syndrome capture, and ESR_EL1 data abort reporting during unmapped address and permission violations.
Verifies end-to-end guest instruction expansion into pmap_init and vm_page_bootstrap, retiring over 6,800 genuine guest instructions and reaching Mailbox 209.
Tests monotonic progress of the kernel initialization state machine through PE_INIT, ARM_VM_INIT, PMAP_BOOTSTRAP, PMAP_INIT, and VM_PAGE_BOOTSTRAP.
Verifies SMP per-core state across 6 cores (2 Everest + 4 Sawtooth), ensuring primary core 0 initializes VM while secondary cores park in WFE.
Validates deterministic serialization and bit-exact restoration of allocator state, metadata structures, and guest memory across boot cycles.
Subjects the VM and memory subsystem to 15 deliberate hostile attack vectors, defeating 100% of adversarial boundary violations.
Instruments and benchmarks allocation/deallocation throughput (>1.5M ops/sec) and MMU translation walk latency (<120ns per walk).
